caption: The drawing depicts a single, rusted metal object resembling a worn and old shovel or spade with a flat, roughly rectangular blade and a short handle. The blade is irregularly shaped with a jagged lower edge, and it has two rectangular cutouts near the top. The surface of the metal is textured, indicating rust and wear, and is predominantly brown and reddish-brown in color. The short handle, attached to the blade, is also brown and shows two holes, one near the connection to the blade and one closer to the tip of the handle, suggesting where bolts or screws might have been attached. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background without any additional objects or details, highlighting the central object.
title: Spade
